DIAGNOSIS READY: Cholangiocarcinoma.

The liver function tests show a cholestatic pattern with significantly elevated Alkaline Phosphatase and Bilirubin, while the ultrasound reveals an enlarged gallbladder without stones, which is consistent with obstruction of the common bile duct. This clinical picture strongly suggests a malignancy of the bile ducts rather than cellulitis.
